description: Defines the cyclic_prefix class and related constants/functions for handling cyclic prefix configurations in 5G NR (TS 38.211). Includes methods for validation and length calculation, and a formatter specialization.

classes.name: cyclic_prefix
classes.description: Represents a cyclic prefix configuration with methods for validation and length calculation.

methods.name: to_string
methods.description: Returns string representation ('normal' or 'extended') of the cyclic prefix.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the cyclic prefix configuration is valid for given subcarrier spacing and DFT size.

methods.name: get_length
methods.description: Calculates the cyclic prefix length in PHY time units based on symbol index and subcarrier spacing.
